name: pathcase-audit
description: Detect ASCII case collisions in proposed paths and directory trees.

scripts.check: node --check src/path.js && node --check src/collisions.js && node --check src/index.js && node --check src/walk.js && node --check src/scan-options.js && node --check src/cli-options.js && node --check src/cli.js && node --check bin/pathcase-audit.js
scripts.test:types: tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.json --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run check:source && npm test && npm run test:types && npm run check:package && npm run check:install
